items.title: How many commits a naive force-push destroys as the teammate's unfetched work grows
items.description: This reproduces L3's commitsLostByForcePush calculation: a teammate pushes some number of commits to the remote branch after the developer's last fetch, and the developer then force-pushes their own rebased work without fetching again. Every one of the teammate's commits is discarded — the loss scales exactly 1-to-1 with how much unfetched work existed at push time.
